summary: US forces struck Iran's Chabahar port and possibly the Bushehr nuclear complex, while the IRGC claimed a joint drone-missile operation against American infrastructure. Unverified reports indicate Iranian missile launches toward Jordan and explosions near Hormuz Strait islands. Israel's defense minister threatened a third, more intense attack on Iran as IDF aircraft remain on high alert.
key_points: US military conducted overnight strikes on Iran's Chabahar port with reports of a missile hitting the Bushehr nuclear power plant complex. (Source: @asafroz/51197)
Additional explosions were reported near the Bushehr nuclear facility minutes after the initial strike. (Source: @asafroz/51232)
IRGC stated its naval and aerospace forces executed a joint drone and missile operation targeting US infrastructure including bases. (Source: @VahidOnline/76887)
Unverified reports suggest possible Iranian missile launches directed at Jordan. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/4784)
Explosions occurred on Abu Musa island near the Strait of Hormuz according to Iranian reports. (Source: @inon_yttach/9336)
Multiple blasts were heard in Bandar Abbas, Hormozgan Province. (Source: @shin_persian/7599)
Tehran shipped at least 10 million barrels of crude overnight anticipating a US Navy blockade resumption. (Source: @shin_persian/7612)
Israeli Defense Minister Katz declared readiness for a third attack on Iran with greater intensity than before. (Source: @yediotnews25/132491)

Unverified reports indicate Iranian missile launches toward Jordan and explosions near Hormuz Strait islands. Israel's defense minister threatened a third, more intense attack on Iran as IDF aircraft remain on high alert.

points: US military struck the port of Chabahar overnight, marking a direct attack on Iranian territorial infrastructure. (Source: @asafroz/51197)
Iranian sources report a US missile hit the Bushehr nuclear power plant complex, followed by additional explosions near the facility. (Source: @asafroz/51219, @asafroz/51232)
The IRGC announced a joint naval-aerospace drone and missile operation targeting US infrastructure and bases in the region. (Source: @VahidOnline/76887)
Multiple blasts were heard in Bandar Abbas, Hormozgan Province, suggesting further strikes or air defense activity. (Source: @shin_persian/7599)
Tehran moved at least 10 million barrels of crude and fuel oil overnight in anticipation of a renewed US naval blockade. (Source: @shin_persian/7612)
Russia and China rejected a UAE proposal at the IMO regarding the Strait of Hormuz, opposing unilateral measures against Iran. (Source: @SharghDaily/170916)

Large funeral processions for the 'martyred Leader Khamenei' were reported in Mashhad, Karbala, and Najaf, though the Supreme Leader's status remains unverified. (Source: @presstv/197956, @naya_foriraq/82230)
IDF Chief of Staff stated hundreds of IAF aircraft are on immediate readiness with tens of thousands of personnel monitoring Iran and Lebanon for immediate action. (Source: @idf_telegram/24587)
Defense Minister Katz declared Israel is prepared to attack Iran for a third time with greater intensity than previous operations. (Source: @yediotnews25/132491)
Israeli security officials express growing concern that Palestinian guard committees in the West Bank may acquire firearms, altering the balance of power. (Source: @inon_yttach/9340)
Hamas spokesman Hazem Qassem survived an assassination attempt in Gaza near Haidar Square; his companion Muhammad al-Fayoumi was killed. (Source: @SharghDaily/170915, @almogboker78/17688)
An illegal violent protest occurred outside the Beit Lid military base (Prison 10), with demonstrators entering the military zone before being removed. (Source: @inon_yttach/9335)
Hamas spokesman Hazem Qassem survived an Israeli assassination attempt in Gaza City near Haidar Square; his companion Muhammad al-Fayoumi was killed. (Source: @SharghDaily/170915)

Israeli defense establishment warns that Palestinian local guard committees in the West Bank, numbering dozens and formed over the past year, may obtain firearms and change the security dynamic. (Source: @inon_yttach/9340)
These committees currently operate with clubs and cold weapons but could escalate any friction event into immediate lethal confrontation if armed. (Source: @inon_yttach/9340)
IDF Chief of Staff confirmed monitoring Lebanon closely alongside Iran, with forces ready for immediate action. (Source: @idf_telegram/24587)

An IDF Oketz unit dog named 'Mars' was killed during operations in Bint Jbeil, southern Lebanon; the handler returned fire and Golani Battalion 8112 eliminated one militant and captured another. (Source: @New_security8200/202363)
Sirens sounded at Camp Victoria near Baghdad International Airport, indicating a potential threat or attack in the vicinity. (Source: @shin_persian/7608)

Massive funeral processions for the 'martyred Leader Khamenei' were held in Karbala and Najaf, with Iraqi Hashd al-Shaabi participation and extensive media coverage. (Source: @naya_foriraq/82230, @naya_foriraq/82234)
An Iraqi Hashd al-Shaabi leader, Abu Fadak al-Mohammedawi, was seen leading mourners in Mashhad. (Source: @naya_foriraq/82219)
Qatar and Pakistan are reportedly working to bring the US and Iran back to the negotiating table, per CNN sources. (Source: @naya_foriraq/82227)
Russia and China rejected a UAE proposal at the International Maritime Organization regarding the Strait of Hormuz, citing the principle of safe and free navigation. (Source: @SharghDaily/170916)
Axios reports the US believes it has room to escalate because hundreds of tankers have transited the Strait recently, reducing immediate oil price shock concerns. (Source: @VahidOnline/76888)
Iran's Parliament Speaker Qalibaf warned the Strait of Hormuz will only reopen under 'Iranian arrangements,' not American threats. (Source: @VahidOnline/76888)

sections.threat_assessment: The conflict has entered a dangerous escalation cycle with direct US strikes on Iranian soil, including potentially a nuclear facility, and Iranian retaliatory operations against US bases. The Strait of Hormuz remains a flashpoint with both sides threatening closure and military action. Israel's explicit threat of a third, more intense attack on Iran, combined with IDF high readiness, suggests a coordinated US-Israeli pressure campaign. The unverified missile launches toward Jordan, if confirmed, would expand the geographic scope significantly. The reported death of Supreme Leader Khamenei, if true, would introduce extreme regime instability, but current evidence suggests this may be disinformation.
sections.regional_response: Qatar and Pakistan are attempting diplomatic mediation to return parties to negotiations. Russia and China have diplomatically supported Iran by rejecting the UAE's Hormuz proposal at the IMO. Gulf states remain concerned about energy transit security, with the UAE pushing for international action while Iran insists on its own conditions for Strait access. Iraq hosts large mourning processions for Khamenei, reflecting Iranian influence, while also experiencing sirens at a base near Baghdad Airport, indicating potential spillover.
sections.intelligence_notes: The 10 million barrel oil shipment suggests Iran expects imminent blockade and is maximizing revenue before potential export disruption. The IRGC's claimed joint operation signals integrated command between naval and aerospace forces. Israeli concern about West Bank guard committees arming indicates a potential new front of localized but widespread instability. The conflicting reports on Khamenei's status require urgent verification; funeral processions in Iran and Iraq may be orchestrated for domestic cohesion or deception. US officials' 'slap them hard' rhetoric indicates a strategy of calibrated escalation to force negotiations.
